description: Save bookmarks with title, URL and tags; search, filter, and export them as JSON.

faqs.a: Type or paste the full address (https://…), give it a title, optionally add comma-separated tags, and click Save Bookmark.
faqs.q: How do I add a bookmark?

faqs.a: The search box matches the title, URL and tags together. The tag filter dropdown shows only bookmarks with that tag.
faqs.q: How do search and filters work?

faqs.a: Click Export JSON to download a file with all your bookmarks, which you can back up or import elsewhere.
Bookmarks live in this browser's localStorage only — private to this device, and they disappear if browser data is cleared.

howto: Paste the URL and give it a title.
Add comma-separated tags (optional) for easy filtering.
Click Save Bookmark — click a saved row's × to delete it.
Use search or the tag filter to find things, or Export JSON for a backup.
title: Bookmark Manager
